response.overview: The first programme features the story of David Brown Tractors - a key name in British Tractor history- from their early beginnings through to the 1960s. We then pick up the David Brown story in the 1970's in the second installment, when the use of these well-loved tractors expanded from working on the larm, to the production of industrial models for use on the highways. We look at a number of models hard at work in a variety of situations. In the final installment of the David Brown story, we come up to date, with numerous purchasers, including CASE IH, and the subsequent development and production of new machines.
response.title: David Brown Tractors
